general.description: This panel defines some global settings for the alarm.

disarm_after_trigger.heading: Disarm after triggering
disarm_after_trigger.description: Automatically disarm the alarm rather than returning to the armed state.

ignore_blocking_sensors_after_trigger.heading: Ignore blocking zones when re-arming
ignore_blocking_sensors_after_trigger.description: Return to armed state without checking for zones that may still be active.

enable_mqtt.heading: Enable MQTT
enable_mqtt.description: Allow the alarm panel to be controlled through MQTT.

enable_master.heading: Enable 'All partitions' panel
enable_master.description: Creates an alarm entity for controlling all partitions simultaneously.

modes.title: Alarmo Arm Modes
modes.description: Alarmo's arm modes (Away, Home/Stay, Night, Vacation, Custom): which ones each Alarmo partition offers, and Alarmo's exit and entry delays for each. With a physical panel, its own delays still apply to its own zones.

modes.armed_away: Armed away will be used when all people left the house. All doors and windows allowing access to the house will be guarded, as well as motion zones inside the house.
modes.armed_home: Armed home (also known as armed stay) will be used when setting the alarm while people are in the house. All doors and windows allowing access to the house will be guarded, but not motion zones inside the house.
modes.armed_night: Armed night will be used when setting the alarm before going to sleep. All doors and windows allowing access to the house will be guarded, and selected motion zones (downstairs) in the house.
modes.armed_vacation: Armed vacation can be used as an extension to the armed away mode in case of absence for longer duration. The delay times and trigger responses can be adapted (as desired) to being distant from home.
modes.armed_custom_bypass: An extra mode for defining your own security perimeter.

status.heading: Status
status.description: Controls whether the alarm can be armed in this mode.

exit_delay.heading: Exit delay
exit_delay.description: When arming the alarm, within this time period the zones will not trigger the alarm yet.

entry_delay.heading: Entry delay
entry_delay.description: Delay time until the alarm is triggered after one of the zones is activated.

trigger_time.heading: Trigger time
trigger_time.description: Time during which the alarm will remain in the triggered state after activation.

mqtt.title: MQTT configuration
mqtt.description: This panel can be used for configuration of the MQTT interface.

state_topic.heading: State topic
state_topic.description: Topic on which state updates are published

event_topic.heading: Event topic
event_topic.description: Topic on which alarm events are published

command_topic.heading: Command topic
command_topic.description: Topic which Alarmo listens to for arm/disarm commands.

require_code.heading: Require code
require_code.description: Require the code to be sent with the command.

areas.title: Partitions
areas.description: Partitions divide the alarm system into parts that are armed separately (for example a detached garage). Each has its own alarm entity, alarm_control_panel.<partition name>; most homes need one.

remove_area.title: Remove partition?
remove_area.description: Are you sure you want to remove this partition? This partition contains {sensors} zones and {automations} automations, which will be removed as well.

disable_master.title: Disable 'All partitions'?
disable_master.description: Are you sure you want to remove the 'All partitions' alarm entity? It has {automations} automations, which will be removed with this action.

add_sensors.title: Add Zones
add_sensors.description: Add more zones. Make sure that your zones have a suitable name, so you can identify them.

area.heading: Partition
area.description: Select the partition which contains this zone.

group.heading: Cross-zone group
group.description: Cross-zone with other zones: several must trigger before the alarm does.

device_type.heading: Zone type
device_type.description: Choose a zone type to automatically apply appropriate settings.

door.name: Door
door.description: A door, gate or other entrance that is used for entering/leaving the home.

window.name: Window
window.description: A window, or a door not used for entering the house such as balcony.

motion.name: Motion
motion.description: Presence sensor or similar device having a delay between activations.

tamper.name: Tamper
tamper.description: Detector of sensor cover removal, glass break sensor, etc.

environmental.name: Environmental
environmental.description: Smoke/gas sensor, leak detector, etc. (not related to burglar protection).

always_on.heading: Always on
always_on.description: Zone should always trigger the alarm.

modes.heading: Arm Modes
modes.description: Arm modes in which this zone is active.

arm_on_close.heading: Arm after closing
arm_on_close.description: After deactivation of this zone, the remaining exit delay will automatically be skipped.

use_exit_delay.heading: Use exit delay
use_exit_delay.description: Zone is allowed to be active when the exit delay starts.

use_entry_delay.heading: Use entry delay
use_entry_delay.description: Zone activation triggers the alarm after the entry delay rather than directly.

entry_delay.heading: Entry delay
entry_delay.description: Override the entry delay (as configured for the arm mode) with a delay specific to the zone.

delay_on.heading: Delay on
delay_on.description: Zone must remain active for this duration before triggering. Resets if zone deactivates.

allow_open.heading: Allow open initially
allow_open.description: Open state while arming is ignored (subsequent zone activation will trigger alarm).

auto_bypass.heading: Bypass automatically
auto_bypass.description: Exclude this zone from the alarm if it is open while arming.
auto_bypass.modes: Modes in which the zone may be bypassed

trigger_unavailable.heading: Trigger when unavailable
trigger_unavailable.description: When the zone state becomes 'unavailable', this will activate the zone.

timeout.heading: Time-out
timeout.description: Time period during which consecutive zone activations triggers the alarm.

event_count.heading: Count

code_mode_change_required.heading: Require code for switching mode

is_override_code.heading: Is override code
